scripts.name: Get-WslStatus
scripts.command: wsl --status

scripts.name: Get-WslDistros
scripts.command: wsl --list --verbose

scripts.name: Get-NerdctlProbe
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl --version

scripts.name: Get-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl container ls -a --format json

scripts.name: Create-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl container create --name {id} {image}

scripts.name: Start-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl container start {id}

scripts.name: Stop-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl container stop {id}

scripts.name: Remove-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl container rm {id}

scripts.name: Rename-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl container rename {id} {newName}

scripts.name: Restart-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl container restart {id}

scripts.name: Get-Image
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl image ls --format json

scripts.name: Pull-Image
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl image pull {image}

scripts.name: Pull-HelloWorld
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl image pull hello-world

scripts.name: Get-ContainerLogs
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu timeout 25 nerdctl container logs --tail=1000 {id}

scripts.name: Exec-Container
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl exec {id} {command}

scripts.name: Get-ContainerInspect
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl container inspect {id}

scripts.name: List-ContainerFiles
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl exec {id} ls -1a {path}

scripts.name: Read-ContainerFile
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl exec {id} cat {path}

scripts.name: Write-ContainerFile
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl exec {id} sh -c "printf '%s' '{content}' | base64 -d > '{path}'"

scripts.name: Write-ContainerFile-Temp
scripts.command: echo placeholder

scripts.name: Delete-ContainerFile
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl exec {id} rm -rf {path}

scripts.name: Export-ContainerFile
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl exec {id} sh -c "cat \"$0\" | base64 -w0" {path}

scripts.name: Get-ImageHistory
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl image history --format json {id}

scripts.name: Get-ImageInspect
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl image inspect {id}

scripts.name: Set-ContainerRestart
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl update --restart {policy} {id}

scripts.name: Get-ContainerRestartPolicy
scripts.command: echo no

scripts.name: Restore-AutoStartContainers
scripts.command: echo restore

scripts.name: Search-Image
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl search --format json --limit {limit} {term}

scripts.name: Create-Network
scripts.command: wsl -u root -d Ubuntu nerdctl network create {name}

scripts.name: Get-ImageDetail
scripts.command: echo detail
